B keeps the headline and subline larger and grouped, but jams them against the top and leaves a big dead gap above a stranded CTA, with the bottom quarter empty and the layout top-heavy.

A has the same problems: everything shrunk, a tiny subline and CTA label, and elements spread evenly and loosely down the canvas. Even so, the CTA is still a usable button.
